name: 두두
outfit: 금색 자수가 놓인 짙은 청색 전포
accessories: 몸 주위를 회전하는 마법 불꽃 조각
silhouette: 거대한 쇠망치를 든 뭉툭하고 단단한 체형
signature_motion: 망치를 크게 휘둘러 바닥을 내리치는 동작
signature_vfx: 망치가 땅에 닿을 때 사방으로 퍼지는 밝은 금색 불꽃 파동
visual_en: A small 2-head tall chibi Dokkaebi facing right. The character has short, spiky deep navy hair with two small, shining golden horns. Tiny magical fire sparks in bright cyan float around the body. The face features glowing golden eyes on copper skin. Wearing a thick, deep navy traditional Jeonpo with bright gold embroidery and heavy leather wrist guards. Holding a massive, heavy iron hammer that glows with intense golden light. The feet are clad in sturdy, thick-soled straw boots. The entire silhouette is accented by bright, saturated golden highlights that stand out against dark backgrounds.
pose_en: A vigorous stance, leaning forward as if about to strike the anvil.
vfx_en: A radiant golden shockwave bursting from the hammer's impact.
lore: 도깨비 대장장이 — 두드려 금을 낸다, 근접. 무기 방망이 · 망치.
concept: 이 게임 세계(요괴 · 이면 — 한국 설화) 영웅. 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.
anchor_edits: Remove the glowing halo ring floating above the head completely. Keep everything else exactly the same: face, hair, horns, ears, outfit, colors, weapon, pose and size.

body_plan.body: A small, humanoid character with blue hair, horns, and dark clothing.
